label: Mega Lucario ex / Solrock (Hariyama & Lunatone variants)
summary: Mono-Fighting evolution-beatdown that grinds 6 prizes behind a 340-HP, 3-prize Mega Lucario ex (single hop off Riolu; Mega Brave 270 self-locks every other turn, Aura Jab 130 self-fuels energy from discard) with a Solrock+Lunatone draw engine and Hariyama gust-on-evolve. Dominant seam: the entire line is Psychic-weak, so ~170 Psychic OHKOs the 3-prize Mega; failing that, snipe the fragile 80-HP pre-evos (Riolu, Makuhita) to deny the payoff for a 1-prize trade.

threats.why: 340 HP, 3 prizes; wincon AND accelerator. Mega Brave 270 (300 with Premium Power Pro) but self-locks next turn; Aura Jab 130 reattaches up to 3 Fighting Energy from discard to the bench. Psychic-weak, so ~170 OHKOs it.
Wild Press 210 (70 recoil) plus Heave-Ho Catcher: on evolving from hand it gusts a benched Pokemon Active the same turn (a free Boss's Orders), enabling surprise KOs on our setup/support.

targets.why: 80 HP, 1 prize, Psychic-weak Basic; the sole single-hop path to the 3-prize Mega Lucario ex (no intermediate stage). Snipe/gust + KO before it evolves to deny the wincon for a 1-prize trade.
80 HP, 1 prize, Psychic-weak; the sole path to the 210-damage gust-attacker Hariyama. Snipe before it evolves to deny the secondary attacker and its Heave-Ho Catcher gust.
Mega-ex = 3 prizes on KO; Psychic-weak (~170 to OHKO the 340 HP). Force it Active or OHKO via weakness for a game-swinging 3-for-1(/2) prize haul.

Load-bearing for two systems: it enables Lunatone's Lunar Cycle draw-3 AND is the Cosmic Beam (70, weakness-proof) attacker. 110 HP, Grass-weak. KO breaks both. Disruption is a tempo lever, not a kill (deep Trainer suite backstops raw draw).
The draw-3 half of the engine (Lunar Cycle: needs Solrock in play, discard a Fighting Energy to draw 3). 110 HP, Grass-weak. KO/gust to throttle card flow and force reliance on Supporters alone.
